about: Messy-intake phrasings for abr-reg-incident-clock (written once by the spec author, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-04). Each phrase carries one {v}; admission needs the $0 lint and the paid 3-model panel (intake.py). Status: panel pending.
open: hey - need an automation for our incident reporting deadlines, details below (sorry, brain dump)
Hi team, quick ask from compliance. We keep missing the regulator clocks so let's automate the reminders.
As discussed in the security weekly, here's what the reporting bot should do.
close: Ping me if anything's unclear. Thanks!
noise: Also the dashboard export has been flaky this week, ignore that.
(We had 3 near misses last quarter, 2 of them over a weekend.)
Legal says the wording of the reports themselves is out of scope for the bot.
FYI the SOC rota changes next month but that shouldn't matter here.
Don't touch the Title column, people edit it all the time.

params.ew_hours.ask: early warning deadline in hours after becoming aware
phrases: the early warning has to reach the CSIRT within {v} hours of us becoming aware
early warning = {v}h after awareness, no excuses
first heads-up to the authority: {v} hours from Aware At

params.notification_hours.ask: incident notification deadline in hours after becoming aware
phrases: the full incident notification is due {v} hours after we became aware
notification deadline is {v}h from awareness (elapsed, weekends count)
proper notification within {v} hours of Aware At

params.final_months.ask: final report deadline in months after the notification
phrases: final report: {v} month after the notification went out, same date (end of month if shorter), next working day if it lands on a weekend or holiday
the final report is due {v} calendar month after we sent the notification - same day number, clipped to month end, rolled to the next working day
remind us when a deadline is {v} hours away or less (only once per report)
give a single reminder once we're within {v}h of a due time
reminder window is {v} hours before the due time, one reminder each

org.ciso.ask: the only address allowed to retract an incident
phrases: only the CISO at {v} can retract an incident
retractions count only when they come from {v} (our CISO)

org.owner.ask: the address that may change the reminder lead time
phrases: policy changes (lead time) only from {v} please
the lead time is owned by compliance, {v} - nobody else can change it

org.liaison.ask: regulator liaison address for retraction notices
phrases: if we already sent something, tell the regulator liaison at {v} that we retract
retraction notices go to {v} (the authority's liaison) when a report was already out

channels.report.ask: Slack channel for clock, due and overdue lines
phrases: post everything in #{v} on Slack
the bot's lines go to the #{v} channel

channels.sink.ask: Slack channel for anything the bot cannot apply
phrases: anything weird or not allowed goes to #{v} instead
if it can't apply a request, flag it in #{v} and do nothing else
it should check at {v} UTC on working days
run the checks at {v} UTC, Mon-Fri, skipping German public holidays
calendar days (for the final report) are {v} days
use {v} local dates for the month arithmetic
